link.note: Wife of James Tuthill per Alva Tuttle (1968) and McCurdy; her parentage (Jonathan Browne & Elisabeth Salmon) comes from compiled sources only (WikiTree getAncestors of Tuthill-530). Supported by 'my brother Joseph Brown' in John Tuthill III's 1740 will and Joshua Brown as executor of Daniel Tuthill (1761).

summary: John's 8th-great-grandmother, wife of James Tuthill; through her come the Browne, Salmon and Horton (Barnabas Horton of Southold) ancestors.
bio: Married James Tuthill about 1714. Not in the Ancestry tree, which instead shows 'Hannah S Reeve' as James's wife (an error merging Joshua Tuthill's marriage). WikiTree gives her parents as Jonathan Browne (1653–1710) & Elisabeth Salmon of Southold; Elisabeth was daughter of William Salmon (d. 1657) and Sarah Horton, daughter of Barnabas Horton of Southold, born Mowsley, Leicestershire. Brown executors in two Tuthill branches fit the marriage.
sources: NY Wills vol. III Liber 15 pp. 400–1; vol. VI Liber 23 p. 130
openQuestions: Birth and death dates; a primary record of her parentage.
